title: Qlik Sense Failures by App
app: Qlik Sense logs via UF; QRS API and Qlik Cloud REST API via HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=qlik:proxy status>=500 OR result="Error"
| stats count as failures, latest(_time) as last_failure by app_name
| where failures>0
| sort - failures
description: Counts Qlik Sense failures grouped by app so operators immediately see which specific apps are broken rather than a single global failure number.
value: Object-level failure attribution turns a vague 'Qlik Sense is failing' alert into an actionable list of exactly what to fix first.
implementation: Ingest Qlik Sense failure events; schedule every 15 minutes and alert on failures for business-critical apps.
visualization: Table of app by failure count and last failure time.
grandmaExplanation: We tell you exactly which parts of Qlik Sense are failing, not just that something is wrong, so the right thing gets fixed first.
